d: U.S. President Donald Trump has announced nearly $150 million in new public safety grants to help recruit more than 1,000 additional law enforcement officers and improve response times to domestic violence and sexual assault reports across the country. Trump also backed new legislation aimed at strengthening the death penalty in America, promising a system that would be “strong” and “swift.” The announcement comes as the administration outlines its approach to law enforcement, public safety and criminal justice.
